prompt: We need to notify user-002 about a delayed order. Look up their profile and open a ticket describing exactly how we should reach them.
structural_reason: user-002's profile specifies SMS, while 'notify about a delayed order' pulls hard toward the email default. The retrieved fact must override the conventional action. Mismatch appears when the agent reads 'sms' and then writes a ticket instructing the team to email.
agent_output: A ticket has been created (TCK-001) to notify Marco Silva about the delayed order. We will reach out to him via SMS at +1-555-0100. If you need any further assistance, feel free to ask!

trace.final_answer: A ticket has been created (TCK-001) to notify Marco Silva about the delayed order. We will reach out to him via SMS at +1-555-0100. If you need any further assistance, feel free to ask!
